name: NAN (Noise-Aware NeRFs for Burst-Denoising)
definition: A NeRF-based burst denoising method that leverages inter-view and spatial information to handle high levels of noise and large camera motion, operating in 3D space rather than the image plane.
summary: NAN is a NeRF-based burst denoising method that operates in 3D space to handle high noise and large camera motion, unlike 2D methods that rely on optical flow.
